name: Beak and Skiff Apple Farms, Inc.
description: Beak and Skiff Apple Farms, Inc. is an agritourism farm in 5089 Cherry Valley Turnpike, NY, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
